intro: Hump Day Hustle: Kansas Cash took a victory lap after Grok's Josh Downs trade pick came true, zoomed all the way in to the 5-millisecond chart, and unveiled a three-step trading plan with a mysterious Step 2. Visionary stuff.

items.caption: Called it! Grok pitched trading a 2027 4th for Josh Downs from the Colts, and the deal went down. Our guy just let the receipts speak for themselves.
Still running the film room after the deadline. Told he's as big as Josh Downs, he pivoted to the real question: strength, or just not being used the right way? Coach brain never clocks out.
items.quote: @RockChalker @T0MFRAUDY idk, maybe it’s a strength issue then, or they are not using him in the right way.

items.caption: A heartfelt salute to Elon for a post saying there has to be some room in this world for sentimentality, even over profit-maximizing. Short, sweet, sincere.
Opening bell analysis at the highest possible resolution. Why settle for a daily candle when the 5 millisecond chart is RIPPING?
items.quote: $SPY ZOOM IN TO THE 5 MILLISECOND CHART!! IT"S RIPPING

items.caption: The day's crowd favorite: a foolproof three-step plan. Step 2 is still under construction, but the confidence is fully built. 8 likes from people who've followed the same plan.
items.quote: $SPY the plan: Step 1. Open Trading Account Step 2. ?????? Step 3. File bankruptcy

items.caption: An inspiring afternoon success story: a very few traders go on to live moderately successful lives, by joining the working poor. Aim high, everybody.
items.quote: $SPY $TSLA After trading some people (very few) go on to live moderately successful (by joining working poor) lives.
